harnessFailures.detail: Initial focus/coordinate attempts entered a path into the wrong control; no fixture or output was overwritten.

The colon keysym produced semicolon in the actual native filename; Windows treated C;\... as relative and reported path not found. Shift_L+semicolon produced a real colon; the native dialog then listed both pinned PNG inputs.

noVNC keyboard textarea input did not establish reliable Chinese text in the application field. Cancelled without saving; Chinese filename was retained from source and changed through the GUI format selector.
Initial browser-source path omitted dialog/ and returned 404; Git tree gave the actual pinned dialog/ubrowseimages.pas and .lfm files.

After an externally observed VM reboot, graphical-session.target and CompatForge were inactive before normal login; CLI socket query failed. Normal authorized login activated the existing service, with all 178 Core jobs and 63 Store rows preserved.

A batched Down/Return sequence selected JPEG and opened JPEG options before output-folder edits. Cancelled without submission; exact new-generation Pictures/市场图像.jpg absence verified. Subsequent explicit GUI dropdown selection saved LZP and 24-bit PNG to ForgeQA/output.
Host Python 3.9 did not provide Pillow. Parent and independent reviewer used separate standard-library PNG chunk/CRC/filter decoders. No product dependency was added.
